research_name: Phenom job creation workflow competitor benchmark

competitors.name: Workday
competitors.posting: Separate internal or external posting associated with a requisition.
competitors.publishing: Usually represented by posting an eligible requisition.
competitors.expiry: Posting end date; behavior can depend on configuration.
competitors.unposting: Remove or end an individual posting while the requisition can remain active.
competitors.reopen_behavior: Treat closed requisition as terminal for this benchmark; verify tenant configuration.

competitors.name: SAP SuccessFactors
competitors.posting: Posting-type record, often internal or external, with start and end dates.
competitors.expiry: Posting end date removes the posting when configured.
competitors.unposting: Remove Post; date changes may require remove and repost.
competitors.reopen_behavior: Can return to a prior state depending on configuration.

competitors.name: Greenhouse
competitors.posting: Separate job post; a job can have multiple posts and openings.
competitors.publishing: Activates the job post on a configured channel.
competitors.expiry: Often represented by scheduled unpublish or an application deadline.
competitors.unposting: Unpublish the post while preserving the job and recruiting data.
competitors.reopen_behavior: Job can be reopened according to workflow configuration.

competitors.name: Ashby
competitors.posting: Distinct listing attached to an Open job.
competitors.publishing: Makes the posting live; visibility can be Listed or Unlisted.
competitors.expiry: Application deadline can automatically unpublish the posting.
competitors.unposting: Unpublish prevents new applications; Unlisted is hidden from normal lists but direct-link applications remain possible.
competitors.reopen_behavior: Verify whether reopening returns the job to draft or open in the configured workflow.

competitors.name: Workable
competitors.posting: Channel distribution to career page, free boards, premium boards, or feeds.
competitors.publishing: Job visibility transition; may include an in-review step.
competitors.expiry: Channel or promotion-dependent; no single universal job expiry.
competitors.unposting: Remove public visibility; archiving is stronger.
competitors.reopen_behavior: Unarchive can restore visibility; verify exact status transition.

competitors.name: Personio
competitors.posting: External promotion of a published job through selected boards.
competitors.publishing: Makes the job visible on the career page; promotion distributes it externally.
competitors.expiry: External posting end date produces Expired status.
competitors.unposting: Cancel or remove a promotion before its end date; may be irreversible for an individual posting.
competitors.reopen_behavior: Reopening returns the job to Draft in the benchmarked behavior.

caveat: Vendor workflows are configurable and should be verified against current product documentation before external publication.
